sections.note: rc3 — global footer, see proposed rule

proposed_rules.trigger: A bottom-of-page block with the line 'The best no-code platform for ...' followed by a thin '| |' separator/social row, appearing verbatim at the end of nearly every captured page across templates.
proposed_rules.decision: Treat as global site footer chrome; exclude from per-page block inventory and model once as a shared footer fragment.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical wording/layout recurs across landing, compare, and category templates — a shared footer partial, not page content.

provenance.evidence: C128 rc3c1c1/c1c2 'The best no-code platform for...' + '| |'

proposed_rules.trigger: A large full-width [bg:color]/[bg:gradient] zone mid-page (not a listing page) with no child text nodes, sized like a product screenshot or embedded video/widget.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag for Phase 2 targeted DOM/media extraction as an image or video block; do not conclude the zone is purely decorative background.
proposed_rules.rationale: Distinct from the confirmed underrendered-list-zone rule (which covers listing/card grids): here the empty zone sits inside a product narrative and most likely holds a screenshot or demo asset that failed to render at minWidth.

provenance.evidence: C128 rc2c2 [bg:color] 1280x968 with zero child text nodes

proposed_rules.trigger: A [region] node appears as a top-level sibling of the root, outside its FAQ container, duplicating an answer already implied by a question row inside the FAQ block.
proposed_rules.decision: Fold the promoted region into its matching FAQ accordion row as the answer cell; do not emit as a separate block.
proposed_rules.rationale: page-tree promotes elements rendered outside their DOM parent (open accordion panel), duplicating content already covered by the FAQ accordion.

provenance.evidence: C128 rc4 (nested c4c1-c4c3) [region] 'Knack Health is a healthcare a...' top-level sibling of rc3

notes: Product landing page. rc2c2 is a suspiciously empty 968px band right after the hero — likely a screenshot/demo video not captured; flagged for Phase 2 rather than dropped.
